theme: A clear calendar with the girls home — time for the holiday bookings.
greeting: No meetings today, Dan, and the girls are with you and Mike through Halloween. It's the clear stretch to settle the Christmas travel that's been sitting on the board, then an easy pot-roast evening.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV — refundable
needsAttention.detail: On your Mike + Dan board since mid-September and now about six weeks overdue. A full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out; a refundable hold placed today costs nothing and clears the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Also on the board — all four girls over Dec 13 – Jan 2, with a book-by of Oct 15 already behind you. Holiday inventory for six only thins from here, so pick domestic or international and get it booked.

inbox.clear: No security, financial, or job-search mail. Your ICGN Plenary 7 thread is moving on its own ahead of Toronto.

resolved: Panelists are picking up your ICGN run of show — Rachit at Diligent confirmed yesterday he's working the questions with the other speakers before Toronto next week, so nothing is owed from you.
